title: Riff-Diff: computational enzyme design by catalytic motif scaffolding
summary: The December 2025 Nature version reports Riff-Diff designs for retro-aldol and Morita-Baylis-Hillman reactions, with activities comparable to enzymes optimized by experimental evolution. Six high-resolution structures support near-atomic active-site placement. The abstract describes a hybrid of machine learning and atomistic modelling. The work also has a bioRxiv preprint first indexed in August 2024; the January 2026 journal issue is later than online publication.
organization: Graz University of Technology; University of Graz; Weizmann Institute of Science; BioTechMed Graz

evidence.tested: Designed-enzyme activity and six experimental high-resolution structures.
